title: The Broken Shackle
summary: Former Dres slaver-factors operating from hidden border caches attempt to reopen the northern shackle-run under forged trade passes while Chain-Breaker wardens hunt their signet-presses.

hook.rumour: Have you heard? Iron slave-collars stamped with a fresh border-factor seal were pulled from the reeds near Percolating Mire, and the Chain-Breaker clans at Thorn are calling for trackers.
hook.notice: BY WORD OF THE BROKEN-CHAIN WATCH: Any traveller sighting ash-canvas barges or iron shackle-presses between Percolating Mire and Thorn is to report to the reed-wardens at once.

npcs.name: Warden of Thorn
npcs.greet: Have you heard? Iron slave-collars stamped with a fresh border-factor seal were pulled from the reeds near Percolating Mire, and the Chain-Breaker clans at Thorn are calling for trackers.
talk: The trouble across Shadowfen began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Thorn.
If you mean to help the Chain-Breaker Clans of Shadowfen, start by checking the trail between Thorn and Reed Mist Village.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Thorn
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Reed Mist Village is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Reed Mist Village toward Sweet Fen Arch before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Thorn so Root-Speaker Xukas-Tei can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Sweet Fen Arch
npcs.greet: You made good time from Reed Mist Village. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Thornmarsh.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Thornmarsh with a picked guard.
Once Thornmarsh is cleared, return to Thorn to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Thorn
npcs.greet: Root-Speaker Xukas-Tei awaits word on whether the crisis in Shadowfen has been contained.
talk: The elders of Thorn have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Shadowfen owes you a debt for standing between Thorn and ruin.
